lines: Just like the Operator, the Drifter currently has four different voices available to choose from: Owl and Heron as masculine voices, and Raven and Falcon as feminine voices. While all four speak mostly the same lines, there are different inflections for each as well as entirely different dialogue from the Operator.
(Note: Voices are listed here in the same order as the majority of voice files on the wiki for ease of identification.)
- Drifter Heron (A): "What's it gonna be, pal: discussion or concussion?"
- Drifter Owl (B): "Sanity is redrawing the map when you have to. Crazy is throwing it away."
- Drifter Raven (C): "Maybe I don't quit because this is the only game I can win."
- Drifter Falcon (D): "Do the crazy thing first and everything else seems sensible."
- "Comms are bad tonight. How many prisoners, you think?"
- "Easy now. I'm not going to hurt you... Let me get that thing off your face..."
- "Alright... alright. Good to see you too."
- "No, we don't. But you know someone that does."
- "I told you. Don't call me that."
- "Peas in a filo-pod, Ordis. Stay close... in case I come to my senses."

- "I've got work to do. You can lay here all you want, doing nothing, wallowing in ancient grudges. She chose the Tenno. But Ballas and your groveling son... they used her. They'll do it again and again. Burning her up for whatever suits them and tossing the ashes when they're done. They cannot have her."
- "I didn't. More like... I don't have it yet."
- "Unless she sprouts fangs I'm sure it's fine. Besides... there's still another Archon after this."
- "Yeah. Still missing a few from the deck. Hunting that golden freak I figure... what's his name?"
- "--Ballas, right. Pfft-huh, you ought to be more careful. I might not be around next time."

- "--future? Naw... but that'd be a lot easier to get, now wouldn't it? As far as I can make it out: You're the me that got rescued from this shit. And I'm the you that did not. Not sure which of us got it worse."
- "Not here exactly... but yeah, stuck. You got bigger problems, right now at least."
- "Ah. That's my cue I think. Would love to give you a hand and all but... the way this works... seems like finishing this is either: You-you or... me-you. So... what do we think?"
- "Looks like I'm your Operator for now. Don't worry... they'll be fine. You wanna tell me how this works?"
- "Can't be harder than riding a horse can it?"
- "She's going to jack one of their Murexes. I pity anyone who stands in her way."
- "--Ballas will get inside her head just like he always has. And he'll rip out her nervous system by the roots. We gotta stop her."
- "Ya know she saved you. It's your turn. Bring her back safe, kid."
- "Haunted, huh? Nice trick to ward off would-be thieves..."
- "Don't. Might just piss it off more."
- "He put hooks in you that go deep. And you are not back to your fighting weight, lady."
- "Look. You're not yourself. Not yet. We can find the last Archon together..."
- "What do you mean? Feed on what?"
- "Shoulda stayed in Duviri... hmm... could we tuck into the shadows of the wrecked ships for approach?"
- "Right. Get outta here once I'm aboard, okay?"
- "Listen. I never finished rebuilding her. It might have made the difference."
- "This mech won't last. I need to take out this Orphix thing."
- "Remember! Remember what he did to you!"
- "At the end. What did you see?"
- "Always knew that mess was going to come back and haunt me."
- "There's that familiar smell. Looks like the Grineer beat us here."
- "Going to have to scuttle the Zariman. Kuva hounds are dug in like ticks. Can't take any risks with this hellish place."
- "Unnh... that surge came from the Reliquary Drive! What are they doing down there?"
- "You can't be. The crew all died!"
- "Wait. Are you saying that thing I just saw..."
- "You have any idea how dangerous this ship is?"
- "Same old story. Grineer ghosts on my trail no matter where I go."
- "We can talk about it some time when I'm not fighting for my life, okay?"
- "I remember the singing. Picking fruit under those warm lights. Hands stained purple with Lofler Berry juice. You really think things could have been different?"
- "Well, I reckon she can fend for herself. I'll help you with whatever crisis you've got going here, but that's all. I'm not looking for another prison."
- "Yeah, we covered Conceptual Embodiment in T.A."
- ""Though all betwixt is dark and deep, a home awaits us there." Yeah. We really thought we'd make it."
- "You can hold out. I know you can."
- "I'll stop the Grineer. And Kira too."
- "I promise. Don't worry, Quinn. I won't let you suffer."
- "Just... ghosts. I think we all lost today."
- "You say that. But this place... I can't forget what it's put me through. Everyone through."
- "Ever get that feeling you're stuck? Spinning inside your little wheel. Only to find... you're right back where you started."
- "And so it goes. Day by day, year by year, until you're dead... inside. You feel nothing. You're just a prisoner trapped in the spiral of someone else's dream..."
**Let the Left Hand Guide Your Escape**
- "I don't belong here. Shit. I don't even know why I'm talking to you. You're just some Thrax plaything, right?"
- "I'm just looking for a way out here."
- "I'm wondering why the hell this all feels so damn familiar."
- "-You can't be serious. You can keep the doll. I've got to get as far away from this as I can."
- "-some fevered dream. Alright, Teshin. I'll try it your way."
- "So what am I doing here, Teshin? A joyride?"
- "Sure. You want to tell me what's so special about these 'Tenno'? This ain't so hard."
- "It's been too long for me. Maybe I was on that ship... Or maybe... the same way you did."
- "I guess we're born with anger. An instinct like any other. Like squinting at the sun or... flinching from a burn... but some of us... maybe we learn it."
- "You said the Tenno are trying to help me... this paradox stuff. Now you're saying Thrax is one of them? He doesn't seem too helpful."

- "Our whole lives, we run toward it, some 'thing,' some 'one,' some wavering oasis of joy and contentment. Sad thing is... most happiness seems to come by accident. Maybe it's not about getting it... but letting it."
- "I don't want shares-ies. I want out."

- "Nothing's worse than anger, right? It burns your lungs. It ashes the trees. But you can see it, right? And after it passes... maybe something new sprouts up. But resentment... resentment is desolation. It salts the soil so that nothing ever grows again."
- "I always had it. Thrax didn't make this place-"
- "I guess it... felt like a good trade."

- "Sometimes you get stuck. Sometimes you go numb. The color drains away. You stop trying, and that just feeds the spiral going down. Maybe you'll get lucky one day. You see yourself in the mirror and snap out of it. But for some of us... it takes more. A friend. A stranger. A story. A helping hand."

- "Maybe things don't work out the way you thought. Your life, your dreams your 'self.' No matter where you go, there you are. This loop you're in... maybe it's not so bad after all? It's not a trap or a habit, or a sentence. It's just your life, waiting for you to live it."
- "Whatever this is, I'm not leaving you alone with it."
- "D'you mind explaining exactly what you mean by that?"
- "He's gone. It's broken through already. Changing things."
- "Seems so. But that means we can change it too."
- "That convoy's a trap. I doubt Entrati's even on it."
- "You do it. I'm not your puppet."
- "But it's not really her that's doing this..."
- "What? Then how would I be any different?"
**Follow the strand to Eleanor and Lettie**
- "Eleanor, only here to help. It's up to you."
- "Then why are you trying so hard to stop me?"
**Follow the strand to Amir and Arthur**
- "Hey, let's get out of here, Arthur. Both of us. Okay?"
